# The generators are numbered s = 0..13: d_1, d_2 (words in a, b, Q0PlaneWords.txt), eps_0..eps_10

#   lines 0-13  the table of generator s: entry i is the index of the image of plane i;

# All entries are re-verified by `q0PlanesOK` (Certificates/Data/RouteP/Q0Planes.lean).
